name: Check animation
summary: Green circle that draws in, then a tick stroke draws inside it, with a small burst of dots; for correct answers.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; circle is 300 px across at s = 1

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
